svg.title: Contribution — cycling views
svg.desc: Contribution activity for the last year, cycling between a reactor, a neon metropolis, a circuit board, a mountain terrain, an isometric city and an isometric rally stage. 1,408 contributions.

g.text: $ reactor --spin 366d # one ray per day, out from the core
$ fab --board 12-layer # a month per chip, a day per pin
$ survey --elevation 365d # one ridge per year, peaks are busy days
$ rally --iso --stage WRC # switchbacks down the mountain, surface = intensity
